reviews.title: A decent quality power supply unit
reviews.comment: The product does what you'd expect it to, and seems to work fine out of box when attached to a desktop. The model that I had is non-modular, and seems to have all the cables that you'd need, including a 16 pin 12 volt cable if you need that. The 650 W model only has a "daisy chain" PCIe cable, and due to the cables being stiff, it's not ideal generally, but I could make it work without having to bend the cables in a way that felt unnatural.
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.title: Top notch, for the money
reviews.comment: had this for several months now.  Its been rock solid.  Really, a substantial deal. Running full time, a serious rig: tuned AMD 9700x Gigabyte B650 Gaming AX v2 32gb @ 6200mhz (cl/cas28) 3 NVMes (one PCIe 5  the rest at PCIe4) 2 sata HDs plus an SSD sata 2 gsync/freesync monitors plus a Samsung OLED S90C (4k 55") when i am gaming driven by a RTX 5070 ti OC graphics card its been flawless, for months after months now.  And, while, obviously, my system has a lot going on, I've seen my measured power consumption spiking up to 550watts, here and there, that's only the most demanding games I got. Most everything else is far less power hungry than that,  most demanding games are 500 watt tops.  So, I am not advocating anyone use underpowered PSUs.  Its just a simple fact that most people get way larger PSUs, because of all the lower quality brands out there, people get and use higher spec Power supplies to compensate. this be quite stays cool and calm, even at 600watts, and i am sure, it will, all the way up to 650
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Whisper Quiet - Can't tell it's even on
reviews.comment: Bought this to power an oculink external GPU enclosure. This PSU is true to its name. It is SILENT! I never hear it turn on. The only sounds I hear are the fans on my GPU. I'm very pleased with this PSU and will keep this brand in mind for future builds down the road.
reviews.author: Michael Fortunato

reviews.title: Spare saved my bacon.
reviews.comment: So I bought this as a spare for testing. I purposely went for non modular because keeping track of all the cables is a pita. As soon as I got this, one of my desktops stopped powering on even though the ambient lighting on the mobo indicated power was still being received. I tried everything else and finally bit the bullet and tried the new testing PSU I just got (this one) everything powered on fine. Ended up using this in the machine with no issues and I only had 2 loose cables to manage. So overall, no modular ftw. I ended up buying a 1000w of this same one as my new spare.
